positive_snippets: Need to improve room service because set top box for TV was not available in one of the room, which was promised but later not provided.
Need to work a lot on room management staff is really helpful and friendly to just not satisfy with room standard which was really low than my expectations
negative_snippets: Booked for a official trip. Rooms are spacious but not cleaned, Humidity, Bad smells, unhygienic toilets. They don’t have their own kitchen. They bring food from outside and serve you cold food. Cheating in the name of breakfast, Only one item with tea/coffee will be served if you booked room with complementary breakfast. Towel, water Glass and AC will be switched on your request. Had a bad experience.

The room was good, but I was disappointed with the check-in process. When I booked online, it was clearly mentioned that early check-in (up to 2 hours before the standard check-in time) would be provided, subject to availability. I arrived 2 hours earlier and asked if I could get the room if it was available. I was told that the room was not available. However, as soon as I asked about paying extra charges, I was suddenly offered the room.

This makes it seem like early check-in is only provided if we agree to pay extra, regardless of availability. If that is the case, then the statement about complimentary early check-in is misleading. It defeats the entire purpose of booking online in advance.

I booked this hotel and went there last night. They said "We can't check in with Nepalese passports". I showed Delhi airport's arrival stamp and asked "If your country's immigration officer allows me to enter in this passport, why can't you allow me to stay?" They denied to check in. Then I asked " Can you give me a letter stating that I am not allowed to check in because of being a Nepalese?" All the three boys from counter denied to give that letter too. An old security guard came and tried to convince me that I can't stay in their hotel because I am a foreigner.

I carried my luggage and left at midnight from their hotel. This is ridiculous!
